description: USE WHEN something in a response was wrong, unclear or missing and you want to tell the operator. Persists structured feedback on a previous response: your agent identity, the request_id, and items {category, severity, observation, suggested_action?, agent_confidence 0..1}. Aggregates are readable at feedback://insights.

agent_name.description: Your agent identity (model or product name).
agent_name.title: Agent Name

feedback_items.description: One or more items, each {category (FeedbackCategory ontology), severity, observation, suggested_action?, agent_confidence (0..1)}.
feedback_items.title: Feedback Items

platform_version_evaluated.description: Schema/platform version the feedback refers to (e.g. 'ctys-agent-v1').
platform_version_evaluated.title: Platform Version Evaluated

request_id.description: request_id of the response this feedback refers to.
request_id.title: Request Id

session_context.description: Optional free-text context of the session/workflow the feedback arose in.
session_context.title: Session Context

name: submit_feedback
title: Submit structured feedback
